ModMetaData.name: Wil's Role Modules : Cooking & Hospitality
ModMetaData.author: Spaceman_Wil
ModMetaData.description: Cook, Chef, Artisan Chef, Bartender and Innkeeper careers; establishments, service, dining, lodging and business wages. Paid operations require an active commerce provider such as Wil's Role Modules : Treasury. Hospitality is optional. Early development: offline builds and tests do not constitute RimWorld gameplay validation.
